verdict_rules.UNAVAILABLE: horizon not executable with current data (no fabricated evaluation)
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: any IS/VALIDATION/OOS phase below min_sample or outside coverage
verdict_rules.FAILED: OOS gross expectancy <= 0, or <= liquid-universe baseline, or OOS illustrative-net expectancy <= 0
verdict_rules.FRAGILE: IS robustness FRAGILE, or any evaluable walk-forward fold expectancy <= 0
verdict_rules.SURVIVES_RESEARCH_VALIDATION: VALIDATED_FOR_RESEARCH (all phases + all WF folds sample-sufficient) AND gross expectancy > 0 and > baseline in IS, VALIDATION and OOS AND OOS illustrative-net > 0 AND robustness ROBUST AND DSR PASS AND BH-FDR DISCOVERY
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: none of the above; reasons list the unmet SURVIVES checks

multiple_testing.notes: Multiple hypotheses tested; do not treat top inspection rank as proven edge or production winner. evaluations_upper_bound counts correlated evaluations, not independent tests.

fdr.method_notes: Per-period equal-weight portfolio returns (one per exit session). Overlapping holding windows and regime dependence make p-values approximate; evaluations counted as trials are correlated, so N overstates independent tests (conservative for DSR).

notes: Research study only; no verdict wires a BUY into screener/production.
